title: 第50章 大傻春，你和别人不一样
content_zh:
第50章 大傻春，你和别人不一样-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

《体面》MV拍摄顺利。

得益于上辈子横店演戏经历，魏沐完全能够胜任孟云这个角色。

压力给到糖嫣这边。

她发现在和魏沐的对手戏中，自己渐渐落了下风。

这是不能接受的！！

对方是上戏04级表演系学生。

而自己呢，则是正儿八经中戏02级表演系毕业生。

“我比他早两年毕业，然后还没他演的好？”

这不就证明中戏的教学质量比上戏差嘛！！

糖糖表示不能接受，她要认真了！

这天下午收工，她找到魏沐。

“导演，我有事情想找你商量。”

见对方一脸认真不似开玩笑，魏沐点点头：“行啊，你等我会。我要和几个工作人员看一下今天的拍摄效果。”

有一部分电影为了赶进度，喜欢边拍边剪。

这样能大大提升制作进度，但有得必有失，很难保证质量。

当然，有些导演牛逼，边拍边剪还是能出好作品，比如《盗梦空间》和《指环王》

《体面》MV就是边拍边剪，他希望6月中看到MV发布，所以必须加快进度。

等忙活完手头的工作，时间已经来到晚上10点。

和众人打完招呼，来到休息间，糖嫣还在等着。

黑色丝袜贴肤裹着修长的双腿，她脚尖轻轻勾着白色板鞋，鞋头时不时相互磕撞。

“等了很久吧，不好意思，事情太多。”

“没有，我一直在看剧本，不无聊。”

她抖了抖手上的剧本，露出一个甜甜的笑容。

这女人很喜欢笑，不管是开心难过，还是尴尬，都喜欢用笑掩饰真实的想法。

“你找我什么事？”

“对，有事。”

糖嫣三步并两步来到身边，她凝望着眼前的男人，轻柔的嗓音，是一丝不苟的诚恳。

“导演，我觉得你可以提高对我的要求。”

她不是傻子。

明显感觉到，自那场23次吻戏后，魏沐降低了对她的要求。

有些戏份拍两遍就过，根本不给她表现的机会。

看着一脸认真的“中戏之耻”，魏导演想起了《夏洛特烦恼》中夏洛对大傻春说的话。

糖糖，这是你该考虑的事情吗？

你跟别人不一样，千万别把时间浪费在磨炼演技上....

好好演傻白甜不香嘛。

Chapter 50 Dashachun, you are different from others - "China Entertainment 2008: Starting from a happy breakup"

The "Decent" MV shooting went smoothly.

Thanks to his acting experience in Hengdian in his previous life, Wei Mu is fully qualified for the role of Meng Yun.

The pressure is on Tang Yan.

She found that she was gradually falling behind in the scenes with Wei Mu.

This is unacceptable!!

The other party is a grade 04 acting student at Shanghai Theater Academy.

As for myself, I am a graduate of the 2002 acting department of Zhong Er Ba Jing Zhong Drama.

"I graduated two years earlier than him, and then I wasn't as good at acting as he was?"

Doesn’t this prove that the teaching quality of Chinese opera is worse than that of Shandong opera?!

Tangtang said she couldn't accept it and she wanted to be serious!

After finishing work that afternoon, she found Wei Mu.

"Director, I have something to discuss with you."

Seeing that the other party's face was serious and not joking, Wei Mu nodded: "Okay, you wait and I will do it. I want to check the results of today's shooting with a few staff members."

Some movies like to edit while filming in order to keep up with the schedule.

This can greatly improve the production progress, but every gain must come with a loss, and it is difficult to guarantee quality.

Of course, some directors are so good that they can still produce good works by editing while filming, such as "Inception" and "The Lord of the Rings"

The "Decent" MV was shot and edited at the same time. He hopes to see the MV released in mid-June, so he must speed up the progress.

By the time I finished the work at hand, it was already 10pm.

After saying hello to everyone, he came to the rest room, where Tang Yan was still waiting.

Black stockings wrapped her slender legs tightly against her skin. Her toes were lightly hooked on her white sneakers, and the toes of the shoes bumped against each other from time to time.

"You must have been waiting for a long time. Sorry, there are too many things."

"No, I've been reading the script. I'm not bored."

She shook the script in her hand and showed a sweet smile.

This woman likes to laugh very much. Whether she is happy, sad, or embarrassed, she likes to use laughter to hide her true thoughts.

"What do you want from me?"

"Yes, something happened."

Tang Yan came to her side in three steps and two steps. She stared at the man in front of her, her soft voice was meticulous and sincere.

"Director, I think you can raise your demands on me."

She is not a fool.

It was obvious that since that 23 kiss scene, Wei Mu had lowered his requirements for her.

Some scenes were filmed twice, without giving her a chance to perform.

Looking at the serious "Shame on the Opera", Director Wei remembered what Charlotte said to Dashachun in "Charlotte's Trouble".

Tangtang, is this something you should consider?

You are different from others, don't waste your time honing your acting skills...

Isn't it sweet to play a silly and sweet role?
